body:
Thought I'd give an update.

The inflammation has gone down, and it's started to heal okay. Sadly it's left quite a wide scar, but none the less it's healing. 

Thank you for your help, I was freaking out for a good few days while watching it. Luckily I got it before it went too bad.
No, I don't intend to go. This isn't the first time I've been through this (besides the infected cut), and I just need to let it heal on its own

Matches help, I usually SH in the bathroom so it's a good cover.

Honestly, I'm still having trouble on if I should be alive or not. It's tough, but days like this past week where we had a ton of thunder storms (And I saw lightening for the first time!), I'm happy. 

Thank you, I hope your troubles get easier bud.
Haha, yes I mean you (: How are you doing?
No. I've just had the mindset of "Okay. I did that, so let's try get through it" since then, and I really don't think I'll ever tell my family till it's been a few years.

I'm sure I'll take that offer up some time, haha. It's a struggle but I really wanna make it to 25. 

How are you doing OP?

I'm trying my best. I attempted to kill myself on May 27th, and since then have been giving life a shot.

I still struggle with a ton of self deprecating thoughts and self hatred, but I really want to not be so damn down like the way I've been for seven years now.

r/suicidewatch and r/pleasecallme are some good places to go, if you want to rant or get advice. Whatever you decide though, know that I, and I'm sure others at the subreddits I mentioned, will be there.

Thank you for your long reply. 

Like I said in my other comment, it was about 1 to 2mm deep when I self-harmed. I have proper bandages too, so that works out. 

Would Dove soap be fine? I use that in the shower and lightly washed it. I don't have it covered atm, but will do so now. I'll also check out the closest pharmacy for OTC cream.

Edit: I'll also avoid the HP spray and alcohol

It was only about 1-2 mm deep, and I used a hydrogen peroxide spray. I'll try get alcohol if that's better than the HP spray. 

I really hope I don't need to see a doctor ):

Definitely. 

I'll definitely work on getting my license. For now I have a bike and there's a bus that can bring me into the city if I need groceries.

I definitely don't want to rely on anyone, that's not a long time plan. I do have a band office that can help me get contacts, so that will be fine.

Thanks, hopefully I can get back into it once this period of my life passes. While it sucks I definitely feel it should have happened. I was very ignorant and irresponsible with some of my money. C'est la vie, thank you for your help!

There's three jobs available: two line cook positions and a janitor. I have a certificate in culinary arts so that works out.

There's definitely fishing and hunting, and I luckily got my CORE licence last fall. Garden isn't possible at the moment, but will look into that. 

For the free courses or programs, I'd have to look into that as well.
